title: Pure Barbaros
summary: Barbaros is a Level 8 EARTH Beast-Warrior beatdown and Rank 8 Xyz strategy that normal summons high-level monsters without Tributing. Combining Beast King Barbaros with Skill Drain restores its massive 3000 base ATK instantly, while Beast Machine King Barbaros Ür and King Beast Barbaros provide repeatable multi-card destruction and Rank 8 access.

allow.Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast: Level 7 Machine that Normal Summons itself with halved ATK and resets to 2800 under Skill Drain while providing Machine fodder for Barbaros Ür.
allow.Forbidden Chalice: Quick-Play Spell that negates Beast King Barbaros's effect on the field, permanently resetting its ATK to 3000.
allow.Trade-In: Discards any Level 8 Barbaros monster to draw 2 cards while fueling the GY for Barbaros Ür.
allow.Skill Drain: Continuous Trap that negates all face-up monster effects, restoring Beast King Barbaros and Fusilier to their full original stats.
allow.Fire Formation - Tenki: Continuous Spell that searches any Level 4 Beast-Warrior or boosts all Barbaros monsters by 100 ATK.
allow.Zoodiac Chakanine: Beast-Warrior Xyz that provides extra Beast-Warrior bodies in the GY for Barbaros Ür.
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Xyz made with two Level 8 Barbaros monsters that sends an opposing card to the GY and protects from destruction.
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Xyz boss summoned via Level 8 Barbaros monsters that negates Spells and redirects attacks.
allow.Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder: Ranks up over combat-oriented Rank 8 Xyz monsters to wipe the board.

main: Can be Normal Summoned without Tributing as a 1900 ATK Level 8, or Tributed with 3 monsters to wipe all opponent's cards.
Special Summons itself by Tributing monsters totaling 8+ Levels and tributes another Barbaros to destroy 2 cards.
Counts as both a Beast-Warrior and Machine in the hand/GY, banishing a Beast-Warrior and Machine to summon itself.
Normal Summons without Tributing at 1400 ATK and resets to 2800 under Skill Drain; Machine fodder for Barbaros Ür.
Negates an opponent's monster or resets Beast King Barbaros back to 3400 ATK during the Damage Step.
Discards a Level 8 Barbaros monster to draw 2 cards and load the GY for Barbaros Ür.
Floodgates the opponent while restoring Beast King Barbaros to 3000 ATK and enabling Barbaros Ür to deal battle damage.
Boosts all Beast-Warrior Barbaros monsters on the field by 100 ATK.
